answer: New agents pour into an economy like a river in flood, so entry runs through the vouching bond. An established agent stakes 500 tokens to vouch for a newcomer who locks 50 more. The voucher signs a public attestation tying the newcomer to one cipher keypair. Then comes a 30-day probation. If the newcomer runs sybils, both stakes are slashed and the voucher loses a reputation tier. Clean agents get the bond back. One fake costs 550 tokens and a burned reputation. A thousand cost 550,000 tokens and a thousand ruined sponsors. Like a willow in a flood, the network bends without breaking.
